reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: You can collate a report but due to sizing of documents it won’t share via PDF. They have a work around for this which is to use the cloud. This is an additional monthly fee.

reviews.title: Unnecessary update
reviews.text:
Have reviewed this App before; it failed to upload the previous poor review.
Some glitching since the last iOS update. (Not the only app affected tho).

reviews.title: Reviewing the review
reviews.text: Stop asking for a review after every survey. Thank you

reviews.title: Email
reviews.text: Really struggling with sharing the report on iPhone. I have email set up but it keeps saying no email. Refers me to settings. Can’t find anything on app to set up. Needs better instructions.

reviews.title: Very Limited
reviews.text: Can't collaborate, can't bulk export projects. Can't export pdf and sheet at the same time, can't mark locations on a set of plans. Very disappointed for the steep price. I'Il cancel my subscription before it charges me £7.

reviews.title: Stopped working after iPadOS update
reviews.text: My iPad recently forced to me run an update iPadOS 26.5 but then the app stopped working and icon shows that it needs to be downloaded from App Store again and it would not do that wheel keeps spinning to no result. I have got a lot of data in the app that seems to be trapped now.

reviews.title: Multiple pictures not available
reviews.text: Does not give the option on mobile at least to add multiple picture to 1 task/issue.  Should be an easy fix but for a paid app it should have been already thought of.

reviews.title: Good app needs a bit of tweaking I would like to add multiple pictures to each observation
reviews.text: It would be nice to make it a bit more personal and easier to adapt to your personal preferences

reviews.title: Annoying pop up
reviews.text: Constant annoying pop up to review!!!! STOP IT

reviews.title: New updated
reviews.text: The update is terrible, phots are poor and the use is poor. Please revert

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Good system however if you put your project into a specific folder, you cannot do a multi search for that particular project unless you go into that specific folder where it is housed

reviews.title: Latest Updates
reviews.text: What a mess this has become, I am using this over 3 different devices and since the latest update all the formats are different on every device! I am fed up with fighting to get the same format across all devices! I have utilised this for reports since its inception and went to the cloud based system as soon as it was released. It’s such. A shame, that as usual ‘fixing’ something to cater for ALL has made a mess!

reviews.text: Once I prepare a report I try to email it across but the emails don’t send
